name: Decorative Monstera Leaf Sculpture
description: Celebrate the beauty of nature with the timeless elegance of the Decorative Monstera Leaf Sculpture . Expertly handcrafted from solid mango wood, this artistic décor piece features the iconic monstera leaf silhouette with beautifully carved detailing that highlights the natural grain, texture, and warmth of the wood.

name: Decorative Floral Glass Vase Set
description: Add a touch of timeless elegance to your home with the Floral Glass Vase Set — a beautifully crafted collection of three round glass vases featuring real pressed flowers preserved within clear premium glass. Designed in graduated sizes, each vase showcases delicate orange and amber floral details that bring warmth, softness, and natural charm to any space.

name: Decorative Glass Mushroom
description: Add a whimsical yet elegant touch to your décor with this beautifully crafted Decorative Glass Mushroom. Made from high-quality glass, this charming accent piece features a smooth glossy finish with delicate white spots on the cap and a gracefully swirled stem for a sophisticated artistic look.

name: Valora Table Lamp
description: Elevate your interior with the Valora Table Lamp , a stunning blend of sculptural design and contemporary elegance. Featuring a smooth, rounded silhouette and a luxurious gold powder-coated finish, this statement piece brings warmth, sophistication, and modern charm to any room.

name: Bellora Dome Table Lamp
description: The Bellora Dome Table Lamp is a sophisticated blend of modern elegance and natural warmth. Featuring a striking gold powder-coated iron dome shade paired with a beautifully crafted polished mango wood base, this lamp delivers a timeless aesthetic that complements both contemporary and classic interiors.

name: Gold Arc Table Lamp
description: Bring timeless elegance and modern sophistication into your home with the Gold Arc Table Lamp . Designed with a gracefully curved gold-finished iron frame and a premium white fabric shade, this statement piece blends contemporary style with functional lighting.

name: Silver Linear Opulence Frame Grid Framed Mirror
description: Bring contemporary sophistication to your home with the Silver Linear Opulence Mirror. Designed with an eye-catching interlocking frame inspired by the elegant lines of bamboo, this statement mirror blends artistic craftsmanship with modern luxury.

name: Silhouette Framed Mirror
description: Make a bold artistic statement with The Silhouette Mirror, a contemporary wall accent that combines sculptural design with functional elegance. Featuring an asymmetrical mirror encircled by intertwined twisted metal loops, this striking piece creates a sense of movement, texture, and visual depth.

name: Riviera Wave Framed Mirror
description: Make a bold artistic statement with the Riviera Wave Mirror, a captivating design inspired by the fluid beauty of ocean waves and organic movement. Featuring a sculptural free-flowing frame with graceful curves and a lustrous finish, this mirror brings depth, texture, and contemporary elegance to any interior.

name: 2 Seater Outdoor Patio Set
description: Bring contemporary elegance to your outdoor space with this stylish 3-piece bistro set, featuring two woven rope armchairs and a matching dining table. Designed with a sleek powder-coated metal frame and durable handwoven rope detailing, this set offers both comfort and modern sophistication for patios, balconies, cafés, and garden spaces.

name: Snoopy Metallica Pop Art Frame
description: Add a pop of colour and personality to any space with our Artistic Canvas Frame Collection. Whether you’re styling a cozy corner, a minimalist desk, or a feature wall, these vibrant canvas prints are designed to complement every decor scenario.

name: Abstract Framed Wall Art
description: Bring a touch of sophistication and creativity to your home, office, or any space with abstract wall art that combines timeless design with modern elegance. Abstract art is celebrated for its ability to transform simple shapes, colours, and textures into expressive pieces that inspire imagination and emotion.
